تستنصروا (form X)
# تَسْتَنْصِرُوا (tastanṣirū) /tas.tan.sˤi.ruː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَنْصَرَ (istanṣara)
# تُسْتَنْصَرُوا (tustanṣarū) /tus.tan.sˤa.ruː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَنْصَرَ (istanṣara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
